RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel creates optics of potential unconscious bias and may breach internal civil service diversity guidelines, but it is not definitive proof of discrimination. Both candidates possess strong qualifications, and specific criteria like international project leadership may have tipped the balance.

Do not accuse the panel of bias yet. Instead, follow up firmly on your written feedback and scorecards. If your department has explicit recruitment rules requiring gender-diverse interview panels, you can raise that procedural non-compliance immediately through HR. Otherwise, wait for the formal assessment to evaluate whether the scoring was objective and consistent before deciding whether to lodge a formal inquiry or grievance.
